description: This file defines API endpoints for managing files within a vector store in a machine learning or AI application, including create, list, retrieve, content, update, and delete operations. It uses FastAPI framework with route definitions and request processing logic, and interacts with various utility modules for authorization, provider resolution, and request handling.

methods.name: Dict _update_request_data_with_litellm_managed_vector_store_registry( data: Dict, vector_store_id: str, )
methods.description: Updates the request data dictionary with properties obtained from the litellm vector store registry based on the provided vector store ID.

methods.name: Optional[LlmProviders] _resolve_provider( *, data: Dict, request: Request, )
methods.description: Resolves the LLM provider from request data, headers, query, or body, defaults to 'openai'.

methods.name: None _maybe_check_permissions( *, provider: Optional[LlmProviders], vector_store_id: str, request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Checks whether the user has permission to call the vector store file endpoint based on their API key metadata.
